name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It sharpens fine details in complex scenes without blowing out edges, which directly boosts EXCAVA’s output quality—even a 0.5% gain matters when every fraction counts. The trade-off is extra compute time: depth-aware upscaling is slower than standard methods, but the fidelity gain outweighs the delay.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop—faces blur worse under its depth maps. Instead, test RealVisXL’s face-focused upscaler first; it locks fidelity but avoids Anthropic’s pipeline dependency. Run a blind A/B on 100 faces—if RealVisXL wins by ≥0.5% on face clarity, adopt it; else, revisit depth-aware.
